concepts.def: Environment vocabulary: la contaminación (pollution), el reciclaje (recycling), el cambio climático (climate change), la basura (rubbish).
Weather phrases use hacer and estar: hace sol (it's sunny), hace frío (it's cold), llueve (it rains), está nublado (it's cloudy).
Town vocabulary: el ayuntamiento (town hall), la estación (station), el centro comercial (shopping centre), la plaza (square).
Directions: sigue todo recto (carry straight on), gira a la derecha/izquierda (turn right/left), cruza la plaza (cross the square).
Transport: en coche (by car), en tren (by train), en autobús (by bus), but a pie (on foot).
'Se debería' + infinitive means 'one should': Se debería reciclar más (We should recycle more) — useful for environment opinions.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Topic 4: The World Around Us — a core area of GCSE Spanish.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Topic 4: The World Around Us brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Topic 4: The World Around Us.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
